title: Fix three bugs in a Go NumberUtils package
description: Fix bugs in NumberUtils: Clamp returns max for in-range values (missing val guard), Sign returns -1 for positive numbers, DigitCount returns 0 for n==0 instead of 1.

task_spec.prompt:
Fix three bugs in numutils.go:
1. Clamp: add `if val > max { return max }` before the final return, then `return val` — so in-range values are returned unchanged
2. Sign: change the first `return -1` to `return 1` so positive numbers return 1
3. DigitCount: change `return 0` in the n==0 branch to `return 1` since zero has one digit
All 4 tests must pass.
followup_prompts: Run `go test ./...` to check the current state. Walk me through what bugs you found and fixed. If any tests are still failing, show me the errors and fix them.
Final verification: run `go test ./...` and confirm a completely clean build. Every test must pass — if any are still red, fix them now.
